$comment: Upstream repositories gathered into the AI Agent Office library. `npm run sync` clones/updates them into .sources/ (sparse checkouts where `sparse` is set) and `npm run build:library` regenerates library/ and public/data/. `scan` rules replace the default agents/skills/commands walk for repos with their own layout.
